about: The Making ledger's words (BIBLE 9, 16, 18). Plain data, read by src/ui/making.js. The two verbs are the bible's: MAKE ×1 and MAKE ×6, and no other. Item rows follow BIBLE 16's table (five arrows, three pots, the net); there is no laid-trap row (Q8). Material names are the island's words, not the item catalogue's.
head: MAKING

rows.name: REED ARROW
rows.does: A cane shaft, a gull-feather fletch. Blunt: knocks lamps and vials loose at full draw.

rows.name: BARBED ARROW
rows.does: An obsidian barb that stays in. Pry: tears a tool off its Instrument.

rows.name: BRINE-GOURD ARROW
rows.does: A gourd of brine on the head. Builds Seized: joints stiffen and crack.

rows.name: CINDER-RESIN ARROW
rows.does: Vent resin that catches on impact. Builds Charred.

rows.name: DUST-PUFF ARROW
rows.does: Clouds an Instrument: its lamps go blind for 6 s.

rows.name: BRINE POT
rows.does: A clay pot of brine mist. Slows, and quenches a firebox.

rows.name: CINDER POT
rows.does: A clay pot of resin. Leaves a fire pool where it breaks.

rows.name: DUST POT
rows.does: A dust cloud that blinds and breaks an Instrument's lock.

rows.name: CAST NET
rows.does: Spun out over Pegs and Sickles; it fouls their legs.

planned.about: Recipes for rows the kit cannot make yet (BIBLE 16), shown as tallies so the ledger reads whole.
